promenade--noun.def: A wide path for walking, usually beside the sea.

exorcist--noun.def: A person who performs ceremonies to drive out evil spirits.

hysterically--adv.def: In a way that shows uncontrolled emotion.
hysterically--adv.ex: She laughed hysterically at the news.

rhetoric--noun.def: Persuasive language, often more impressive than sincere.

menacing--adj.ex: A menacing dog blocked the gate.

hamper--verb.def: To make it harder for someone to move or make progress.

succumb--verb.def: To stop resisting a pressure, illness or temptation.
succumb--verb.ex: He finally succumbed to the pressure.

posterity--noun.def: The people who will live after us.
posterity--noun.ex: The letters were kept for posterity.

consignment--noun.def: A load of goods sent to a buyer or seller.

conjecture--verb.def: To form an opinion without having proof.
conjecture--verb.ex: We can only conjecture what happened.

conjecture--noun.def: An opinion formed without solid evidence.

gout--noun.def: A painful disease that swells the joints, often the toe.
gout--noun.ex: Gout kept him off his feet.

mesh--verb.def: To fit together well, as teeth of gears do.

hinder--verb.def: To slow down or block the progress of something.

converse--adj.def: Opposite in direction or meaning to something stated.
converse--adj.ex: The converse claim is also true.

lament--verb.def: To express deep sorrow or regret about something.

dribble--verb.def: To fall in drops, or to move a ball with small touches.

dribble--noun.def: A thin flow of liquid, or the act of moving a ball forward.
dribble--noun.ex: A dribble of oil marked the floor.
dribble--noun.exTr: Yere bir damla yağ iz bırakmıştı.

autopilot--noun.def: A device that steers an aircraft or ship without a person.
autopilot--noun.ex: The pilot switched on the autopilot.

babble--verb.def: To talk quickly in a way that is hard to follow.
babble--verb.ex: The child babbled about his day.

proverbial--adj.def: Referred to in a well-known saying, and so familiar to all.
proverbial--adj.ex: He is the proverbial bad penny.

diminish--verb.def: To become smaller, or to make something seem less important.

wallow--verb.def: To roll about in mud, or to enjoy a sad feeling too much.

exalted--adj.def: Holding a very high rank or being greatly admired.

euphoria--noun.def: A feeling of intense happiness that does not last.
euphoria--noun.exTr: Zafer kısa süreli bir coşkun sevinç getirdi.

apostle--noun.def: An early follower of Jesus, or a strong supporter of an idea.
apostle--noun.ex: He became an apostle of free trade.

equilibrium--noun.def: A state in which opposing forces are balanced.
equilibrium--noun.ex: The market found a new equilibrium.

gambit--noun.def: An opening move made to gain an advantage later.
gambit--noun.ex: His offer was a clever gambit.

requisition--noun.def: An official demand for supplies or property.
requisition--noun.ex: Sign the requisition for the parts.

tenacious--adj.def: Holding on firmly and refusing to give up.

spatial--adj.def: Relating to space and the position of things in it.

infallible--adj.def: Never making a mistake or failing.

instantaneous--adj.def: Happening at once with no delay.

brim--verb.def: To be so full that the contents almost spill over.

mystique--noun.def: The quality of seeming mysterious and specially attractive.
mystique--noun.ex: The brand has kept its mystique.

veritable--adj.def: Used to stress that a strong description really fits.
veritable--adj.ex: The garden is a veritable jungle.

tenacity--noun.def: The quality of holding on and refusing to quit.

sulphur--noun.def: A yellow chemical element that burns with a strong smell.

crippling--adj.def: Causing so much damage that normal function stops.

deviant--noun.def: A person whose behaviour differs sharply from accepted norms.
deviant--noun.ex: The paper labelled him a deviant.

deviant--adj.def: Differing from what society considers normal.

physiological--adj.def: Relating to how the body and its organs function.

homestead--noun.def: A farmhouse together with the land around it.
homestead--noun.ex: They farmed the homestead for decades.

adhere--verb.def: To stick firmly to a surface, or to follow a rule closely.
adhere--verb.ex: All staff must adhere to the code.

notoriously--adv.def: In a way that is widely known for being bad.

venomous--adj.def: Producing poison, or full of bitter hatred.

patronizing--adj.def: Treating others as if they were less capable than you.
patronizing--adj.exTr: Tepeden bakan tonu herkesi rahatsız etti.

pyre--noun.def: A pile of wood built for burning a dead body.
pyre--noun.ex: They lit the pyre at sunset.

indiscretion--noun.def: An unwise act or remark that causes embarrassment.
indiscretion--noun.exTr: Tek bir düşüncesiz davranış kariyerini bitirdi.

euphemism--noun.def: A mild word used instead of a harsher or blunter one.
euphemism--noun.ex: "Let go" is a euphemism for dismissed.

seedy--adj.ex: They met in a seedy bar.

aptitude--noun.def: A natural ability to learn or do something well.
aptitude--noun.ex: He shows an aptitude for numbers.

squirm--verb.def: To twist the body because of discomfort or embarrassment.

topple--verb.def: To fall over, or to remove a leader from power.

contagion--noun.def: The spreading of a disease or a mood from one to another.

philanthropist--noun.def: A wealthy person who gives money to help others.

buzzard--noun.def: A large bird of prey that circles while hunting.
buzzard--noun.ex: A buzzard circled above the field.
buzzard--noun.exTr: Tarlanın üstünde bir şahin daire çizdi.

plume--noun.def: A large feather, or a rising column of smoke or dust.
plume--noun.ex: A plume of smoke rose slowly.

squint--verb.def: To look with partly closed eyes because of light or distance.

recluse--noun.def: A person who chooses to live apart from society.

brimstone--noun.def: An old word for sulphur, used in warnings about hell.
brimstone--noun.ex: The preacher spoke of fire and brimstone.
brimstone--noun.exTr: Vaiz ateş ve kükürtten söz etti.

magpie--noun.def: A black and white bird known for collecting bright objects.

fabrication--noun.def: A story that is invented, or the making of goods.

mediocrity--noun.def: The quality of being only average and not good.

correlation--noun.def: A connection in which two things change together.
correlation--noun.ex: There is a correlation between sleep and mood.
correlation--noun.exTr: Uyku ile ruh hâli arasında bir bağıntı var.

derelict--adj.def: Abandoned and left to fall into ruin.
derelict--adj.ex: A derelict mill stands by the river.
derelict--adj.exTr: Nehir kenarında metruk bir değirmen duruyor.

derelict--noun.def: A person without a home, or an abandoned ship or building.
derelict--noun.ex: The harbour holds an old derelict.
derelict--noun.exTr: Limanda terk edilmiş eski bir gemi var.

embodiment--noun.def: A person or thing that represents a quality perfectly.
embodiment--noun.ex: She is the embodiment of patience.

mediation--noun.def: Helping two sides in a dispute reach agreement.

baroque--adj.def: In the ornate style of seventeenth-century art, or overly elaborate.
baroque--adj.ex: The church has a baroque ceiling.

extracurricular--adj.def: Done at school but outside the required lessons.

extracurricular--noun.def: An activity students do outside their normal lessons.
extracurricular--noun.ex: List your extracurriculars on the form.

kinetic--adj.def: Relating to movement or the energy of moving things.
kinetic--adj.ex: A falling rock has kinetic energy.
kinetic--adj.exTr: Düşen bir kayanın kinetik enerjisi vardır.

cascade--verb.def: To fall or pour down in large amounts.

myriad--adj.def: Very great in number and hard to count.

agility--noun.def: The ability to move or think quickly and easily.

autonomous--adj.def: Governing or operating itself without outside control.

coax--verb.def: To persuade someone gently and patiently.
coax--verb.ex: He coaxed the cat from the tree.

meager--adj.def: Too small in amount to be enough.
meager--adj.ex: They lived on a meager income.
